states.summary: Paid PMPM increased by $23.61 (+33.1%) consistently across the period, from $71.36 to $94.97.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change
description: The change is primarily driven by Cost — Admit Impact: $8.92 PMPM, Cost per Admit Impact: $14.69 PMPM.
Cost per Admit breakdown: ALOS Impact: $8.01 PMPM, CMI Impact: $4.75 PMPM, CMI-adj Cost per Day Impact: $1.92 PMPM.

drivers.title: What Services are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated in DRG 457 (Spinal Fusion Except Cervical with Spinal Curvature/Malignancy/Infection) and DRG 426 (Multiple Level Combined Anterior and Posterior Spinal Fusion Except Cervical with MCC), together accounting for 28.4% of the total cost change, approximately $8.45 of PMPM Change. This reflects new high-acuity spinal cases not present in the prior period, indicating increasing case complexity.
Chronic Neurological accounts for 21.6% of the total cost change.
HMO accounts for 77.9% of the total cost change, with PMPM changing by $18.23.

drivers.title: Which Providers Are Driving It
description: NORTON HOSPITAL: 14.9% contribution, $4.28 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+139.6%).
UC MEDICAL CENTER: 9.7% contribution, $2.74 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+29.2%).

additional_signals: New member mix changed by +4.4 percentage points, from 5.4% to 9.8%.
NPAR/IDR activity contributes 8.2% of the total cost change. IDR cases changed by -32, indicating reduced network pricing pressure.

states.summary: Paid PMPM increased by $25.67 (+24.6%) consistently across the period, from $104.30 to $129.97.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change

drivers.title: What Services are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated in DRG 001 (Heart Transplant or Implant of Heart Assist System with MCC) and DRG 216 (Cardiac Valve and Other Major Cardiothoracic Procedures with Cardiac Catheterization with MCC), together accounting for 14.2% of the total cost change, approximately $6.32 of PMPM Change. Chronic Cardiovascular accounts for 43.4% of the total cost change.
PPO/EPO accounts for 90.6% of the total cost change, with PMPM changing by $24.44.

drivers.title: Which Providers Are Driving It

additional_signals: New member mix changed by -0.2 percentage points, from 8.6% to 8.5%.
